Related insight: Related insight: Tutorial 13 (wasp_13) continues directly from tutorial 12, further extending the RuleGenerator series with additional rule-grammar and generative-assembly techniques for multi-part aggregation. Tutorial 12 is a direct prerequisite for tutorial 13, and the two share closely related content around advanced discrete assembly with rule-generator workflows.

Related insight: Related insight: Tutorial 14 (wasp_14) continues the advanced topics series beyond tutorial 13, extending the progression of the RuleGenerator and advanced discrete assembly workflows. Tutorial 12 is thus an indirect prerequisite for the advanced topics explored in tutorial 14.

intents: create a stochastic aggregation with Wasp

evolution_history.changes: Tutorial 12 currently has no context. Since tutorial 13 is a direct continuation of tutorial 12 in the RuleGenerator series (mirroring how tutorial 11 notes tutorial 12 as its continuation), tutorial 12 should now document its relationship to tutorial 13.

wasp_12 currently notes tutorial 13 as its direct successor. Since wasp_14 continues the series after tutorial 13, it is appropriate to note that the sequence extends further to tutorial 14, making wasp_12 an indirect prerequisite.

curriculum.title: CONNECTION TYPES
curriculum.text:
CONNECTION TYPES
When creating connections for a specific part,
it is possible to assign specific types to each
connection (as a text string).
These connection types will be used by the 
RuleGenearator to decide which connections
are allowed to connect to each other.

curriculum.title: RULE GENERATOR #02
curriculum.text:
RULE GENERATOR #02
If connection types have been set when creating
Connections, it is possible to use the RuleGenerator
to create all possible rules between Connections
of the same type.
To enable this, the TYP input needs to be set to True.
